raw_text: NEW REPORT: We've identified a China-linked group (RedEcho) that has compromised 10 Indian power sector organizations including 4 of 5 Regional Load Despatch Centres. The group used ShadowPad C2 infrastructure. The timing correlates with India-China border tensions. This represents a significant pre-positioning capability that could be leveraged during future geopolitical crises. Full technical analysis with IOCs available in our latest report. Indian CERT-In and power sector organizations have been notified.
